comment: Buckle upstream pool (W1253 Amendment A: fleet config is JSON).

Group name == wire id (the model string clients put in the request body). Loopback-only by committed default; cloud tiers are DORMANT — they appear in the ladder but resolve to zero deployments until an operator supplies them at runtime via BUCKLE_UPSTREAMS (a second JSON merged over this one; keys come from env vars named in api_key_env, never from committed files).

Fields: url (upstream base), dialect (openai | anthropic), optional model (upstream's real model id when the group alias differs — the request body's model field is patched; absent = forward verbatim), optional api_key_env (env var name holding the bearer key), optional priority (non-negative integer; lower wins among healthy deployments of equal fit — set in the machine BUCKLE_UPSTREAMS override).
W206: committed anthropic-dialect rows for the Claude Code model ids are dormant until ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exists at runtime (keys live in env vars, never committed).
W426: dialect no longer walls a group off — same-dialect rows rank first, other-dialect rows translate natively (bodies/SSE, both directions, streaming included); count_tokens never translates.

W219.1 litellm-as-engine pattern (activation = machine BUCKLE_UPSTREAMS override): url http://127.0.0.1:4100, adapter openai-compat, model = litellm model_name, adapter_config {proxy_kind: litellm}, api_key_env LITELLM_KEY.
